id.description: Component id, used to target the component in Dash callbacks.

data.description:
Columnar, DataFrame-derived data produced by `lattice-grid-pandas`:
`{columns: [...], rowKey: "__row_id__", columnar: {field: [values...]}}`.
Rows are reconstructed in the browser (virtualized rendering).

options.description: Grid options passed through to `createGrid` (e.g. edit, rowHeight).

licence.description: Lattice Grid licence key. Empty on localhost runs free/unwatermarked.

cellChanged.description:
OUTPUT. The last cell edit made in the grid:
`{key, colId, value, old, ts}`. Updated on every manual edit so a Python
`@callback` with `Input(id, "cellChanged")` fires. Read-only from Python.

selectedKeys.description: Selected row keys. Set by the grid on selection; may also be set from Python.

licenceState.description: OUTPUT. The grid's resolved licence state (e.g. "localhost", "valid").

style.description: Inline style for the grid host element.

className.description: CSS class for the grid host element.
